current.text: OKC traded him away this offseason, along with Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins. The moves were mostly financial. He now plays for Atlanta.
Atlanta's projected starters are McCollum, Alexander-Walker, Daniels, Johnson and Okongwu. Dort is part of a bench that also includes Wiggins, Landale and Flemings.
He is expected to come off the bench as the sixth man and get the most bench minutes. He will mostly be staggered with Dyson Daniels.
He is expected to play more minutes than Aaron Wiggins, partly on reputation.

If he starts, it would most likely be in place of CJ McCollum. One expert does not expect him to start over McCollum, and starting him over Daniels would be a bad decision because he is the worse defender and offensive player.
Several Atlanta starters handle the ball, so Dort or Wiggins can step in for any of them when one is out.
He could lose minutes or be traded again if Daniels makes him expendable.
He is only worth considering in leagues with 16 or more teams. Lloyd calls him a late swing pick but does not believe in it.

durable.text: Wing defender who is very good at switching onto bigger forwards.
Inconsistent three-point shooter: 39 to 40% from three in two seasons, then 34% last season. He is not afraid to shoot.
